items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: It was a great thrill to play with the symphony.

ctx.x: Well, Fritz Reiner, when he'd come to New York to direct the Philharmonic, he'd always come down to Nick's to hear me play. And, uh, one day he asked me to, if I'd like to come to rehearsal for Philharmonic. I said, sure. And he said, well, bring your horn too.
What do you mean? The play or something? Yes, I wanted to.
